claim: Patchline ships a registered-report submission with in-principle acceptance before results. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the in-principle acceptance claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make registered-report-gate`.
